findings.mechanism: The focus plot and greatness contact the supplied command, restraint, confinement, humiliation, possible inclination, and counter-turning occurrences, operationalizing magnitude as coercive force.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the plot can be called great in terms of the agency it threatens, while the ordinary deceptive reading remains recoverable.
findings.containment: The focus still names the women's plot and evaluates its magnitude; the later pressure sequence develops one attributed measure of that magnitude without making it the only sense.

epistemic.reason: The exact 12:32-12:34 HFT trace is supplied, with two resolved focus branches and seven unresolved context branches retained as attributed.

findings.title: The garment becomes proxy skin
findings.claim: The shirt can momentarily be read as proxy skin: a cut borne by the covering precedes a later cut written directly onto hands.
findings.mechanism: The focus garment and cut contact the supplied surface-and-skin occurrence in 12:19 and the later cut hands in 12:31, creating a bounded material analogy.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the garment as the body's exposed boundary, so the later bodily cutting echoes and intensifies the earlier wound.
findings.containment: The shirt remains an actual garment and the focus cut remains physical evidence; the proxy-skin image is exploratory and does not claim lexical identity between cloth and flesh.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact and bounded, but its cross-domain skin and later-body branches are unresolved attributed nominations.

findings.title: The garment reverses an earlier objectification
findings.claim: The garment's material trace can reverse the earlier objectification: the concealed, undervalued person's covering becomes a counter-document.
findings.mechanism: The focus shirt contacts the supplied concealment, merchandise, sale, and undervaluation occurrences, so materiality shifts from a sign of possession to a trace that resists a false account.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the same person's covering move from the scene of imposed value into evidence that restores his account.
findings.containment: The shirt remains a physical object and the earlier sale remains part of the narrative; the reversal is an exploratory cross-scene analogy, not a claim that the garment literally cancels the sale.

epistemic.reason: The exact context anchors and focus return are supplied, but every contextual branch except the qualified focus garment is unresolved and attributed.
